chunks: "Do you want me to seek for you," he said, "a god other than God, when He has exalted you over all the nations of the world?"
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God says He favored you over the worlds?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-A'raf, this verse captures the essence of divine grace (fadl) bestowed upon the Children of Israel, serving as a rhetorical rebuke to their idolatry despite their elevated status. Shia exegetes often view this as a paradigm for understanding how spiritual privilege can be squandered through ingratitude, linking the historical narrative to the concept of Imamate as the ultimate manifestation of divine favor.
